title: The Wheat Sea
synopsis: The Hush is faster over the downs. Rook hides the dark train in the tall wheat and moves only when the wind blows.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The lamps went out. It's here! Full steam!
It's over the hill. Hold the bar!
It's faster than us! Come on, old girl!
The wheat field! Lights off. Into the wheat!
Down low. The wheat is taller than us.
Listen. When the wind blows, we move.
It heard us! Lights on! Full steam!
Out of the wheat! Go, go!
Harvest Town! Warm bread for everyone!
It will be back. Hold the bar.
